incident.title: New-card payment requests failing inside the Payment Processing Service
incident.alert_or_symptom: Customers using newly entered payment cards are receiving payment-processing errors, while saved-card and digital-wallet transactions continue to complete.

technical_evidence.observation: Of 15,600 payment attempts between 13:05 and 13:25, 42.7 percent failed and 57.3 percent completed successfully. Failures are concentrated in requests using newly entered cards.
Failed requests contain an unhandled PaymentRequestMappingException and stack trace from CardAuthorisationRequestMapper.map while the service is constructing the internal authorisation request.

Traces for failed transactions terminate inside SVC-PAYMENT at the request-mapping operation before any authorisation call is sent to EXT-PAYMENT. Successful saved-card and digital-wallet requests continue to reach the external gateway normally.
PLT-COMPUTE, PLT-DATABASE, PLT-MESSAGING and EXT-PAYMENT are healthy. The external gateway reports normal availability and authorisation success for requests it receives.

Customers across the United Kingdom and Ireland report that newly entered cards fail during checkout. Customers with a saved card or supported digital wallet can continue, but many affected customers do not have either option.
The evidence directly identifies an internal application exception in SVC-PAYMENT. No external-payment, database, messaging, compute, network or credential failure has been identified.

service_impact.user_impact_description: Customers across the United Kingdom and Ireland using newly entered cards cannot complete payment, while saved-card and digital-wallet transactions continue to succeed.
service_impact.workaround_description: Customers with a previously saved card or supported digital wallet may complete payment, but the alternative is unavailable to many affected customers.

environmental_context: The Payment Processing Service is a Tier 1 business-critical application.
The service coordinates payment authorisation and records payment status.
The External Payment Gateway only receives requests after SVC-PAYMENT completes its internal request-mapping operation.
Order browsing and basket functions remain available, but affected customers cannot complete checkout using a newly entered card.
reported_unknowns: The complete set of card-request attributes or combinations that trigger the mapping exception has not been established.
It is not yet confirmed whether any failed attempts created incomplete internal payment records or could create duplicate-processing risk if customers retry.
The expected correction and service-recovery time are unknown.
additional_context: No duplicate charge, payment-status corruption, data loss or serious security exposure has been confirmed.
No recent application deployment or configuration change has been identified during the initial assessment.
